findings.current: The spear Jin Taekyung thrust forward was aimed at Lee Jungryong’s chest.
findings.defect: The spear was thrown or launched at Lee Jungryong, not thrust while still in Jin Taekyung’s hands; Jin subsequently holding a new spear confirms the distinction.
findings.rationale: 쏘아 보낸 describes sending the spear flying as a projectile, so “thrust forward” changes the physical action.
findings.replacement: The spear Jin Taekyung had hurled was aimed at Lee Jungryong’s chest.
findings.source: 진태경이 쏘아 보낸 창이 이정룡의 가슴을 노렸다.

findings.current: Lee Jungryong succeeded in deflecting it, but the spear’s terrifying strength and rotational force tore open his grip, sending blood spraying into the air.
findings.defect: A grip cannot literally be torn open; the source says Lee Jungryong’s hand was physically torn by the spear’s power and rotation.
findings.rationale: 찢어진 손아귀 refers to the injured hand from which blood sprays, not the abstract act of gripping.
findings.replacement: Lee Jungryong succeeded in deflecting it, but the spear’s terrifying power and spin tore his hand open, sending blood spraying into the air.
findings.source: 창을 흘리는 데에는 성공했지만, 가공할 만한 힘과 회전력에 찢어진 손아귀에서는 피가 튀었다.

findings.current: At the same time, a tremendous force struck the sword blade that had seemed ready to pierce Lee Jungryong’s throat.
findings.defect: The draft reverses the target of Lee Jungryong’s sword. He is attacking Jin Taekyung, so the blade is about to pierce Jin Taekyung’s throat when it is knocked aside.
findings.rationale: The surrounding action has Lee Jungryong charging at Jin Taekyung with his sword; 그의 therefore refers to Jin Taekyung as the threatened target.
findings.replacement: At the same time, a tremendous force struck the sword blade that had seemed ready to pierce Jin Taekyung’s throat.
findings.source: 동시에 당장이라도 그의 목젖을 파고들 것 같던 검신을 후려치는 거대한 힘이 있었다.

findings.current: and a formidable figure born of the age.
findings.defect: “Formidable figure” loses the morally charged characterization of 효웅: an exceptionally capable, ambitious hero whose greatness is associated with ruthlessness or unscrupulousness.
findings.rationale: 효웅 characterizes Lee Jungryong’s heroic stature and ruthless ambition, rather than merely saying that he is formidable.
findings.replacement: and a ruthless hero born of his age.
findings.source: 시대가 낳은 한 사람의 효웅(梟雄).

findings.current: He had lived half his life in someone else’s shadow, bearing the name of the second-in-command.
findings.defect: “Second-in-command” assigns Lee Jungryong a specific organizational office, while 이인자 means that he was branded the perennial number two beneath someone greater.
findings.rationale: The passage concerns Lee Jungryong’s inferiority to Cheon Taemin, not a formal position in a chain of command.
findings.replacement: He had spent half his life in someone else’s shadow, branded as number two.
findings.source: 누군가의 그림자에 가려져, 이인자라는 이름으로 반평생을 살았다.

findings.current: “I don’t know. You looked about my age, so I thought I’d say hello.”
findings.defect: The answer changes “just because” into uncertainty and omits that Cheon Taemin was pleased to encounter someone who appeared to be his age.
findings.rationale: 그냥 is a casual “just because,” while 반가워서 explicitly gives pleasure at meeting an apparent peer as his reason.
findings.replacement: “Just because. You looked about my age, and it was nice to see someone my age.”

findings.current:
The early days of the Great Cataclysm.

A man he had met in a desperate Life-or-Death Crisis, surrounded by countless monsters.
findings.defect: Capitalizing “Life-or-Death Crisis” incorrectly presents this ordinary description of mortal peril as the named System Quest. The memory concerns a desperate battlefield situation during the Great Cataclysm.
findings.rationale: 절체절명의 상황 is used descriptively here, with 상황 explicitly identifying it as a situation rather than a System Quest.
findings.replacement: A man he had met during the early days of the Great Cataclysm, when they were surrounded by countless monsters in a desperate, life-or-death situation.
findings.source: 대격변 초기. 수많은 몬스터에 포위된 절체절명의 상황에서 만난 한 사람.

findings.current: Decades passed. Countless emotions rose and faded.
findings.defect: The draft states that decades literally pass during the pause. The source says decades of Lee Jungryong’s life, along with countless emotions, rise and disappear within his mind.
findings.rationale: 수십 년의 세월 is the lifetime of experience surfacing in this instant, as the following sentence explicitly says the interval lasted only a moment.
findings.replacement: Decades of his life and countless emotions rose and faded.
findings.source: 수십 년의 세월, 수많은 감정이 떠오르고 사라진다.

summary: The draft contains two action reversals, obscures a concrete hand injury, weakens Lee Jungryong’s self-conception and subordinate status, incorrectly presents an ordinary life-or-death situation as a named Quest, and alters two reflective passages.
